newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open barely changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open barely changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open barely changed Wednesday as LME merely drifted overnight despite a sharp dip in stocks.
LME stocks fell 2,825 tonnes to 149,300 tonnes.
July COMEX traded between 113.25 and 112.75 cents a lb on ACCESS, and was down 0.35 cent just before COMEX was due to open. July delivery closed at 113.10 cents Tuesday.
COMEX copper stocks fell 1,407 short tons Tuesday to 40,479 short tons.
